TCD.note: Consumer protection law improvement is listed only as a general PATN investment, with no rule drafted or in force stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Terminals are for state revenue counters; no mobile money or retail service described.

facts.fact: The Chad finance ministry received 3,000 smart electronic payment terminals on 24 July 2026, supplied by the World Bank under the PATN project, to modernise public revenue collection; no deployment schedule is stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, funded by the World Bank
